findings.root_cause: Failed safeStorage rd_last write returns false but shadows durable previous bytes; saveLocal did not restore rd_last, making mirror repair ownership comparison fail.
findings.correction: Restore prior rd_last and rd_profiles; require both successful restores before clearing journal after owned mirror compensation.
findings.source_recheck: Original correction remains present in V332-R saveLocal/applyRoomImport; no runtime acceptance claimed

findings.root_cause: New Import/Revision unconditionally replaced pending recovery intents, destroying old rollback values.
findings.correction: Refuse new Import/Revision when either raw pending journal exists; recheck after async archive.
findings.source_recheck: Original correction remains present in V332-R saveLocal/applyRoomImport; no runtime acceptance claimed

findings.root_cause: saveLocal captured rollback snapshots before awaiting archive export; later edits/saves/imports could invalidate those snapshots.
findings.correction: Recheck document identity/epoch, both local snapshot values and journal absence before mutation.
findings.source_recheck: Original correction remains present in V332-R saveLocal/applyRoomImport; no runtime acceptance claimed

findings.detail: No atomic commit/authoritative arbitration across LocalStorage and IndexedDB. Torn generation or commit sidecars cannot rank distinct valid documents.
findings.source_assessment: OPEN: legacy raw payloads, non-atomic sidecars and distinct transactions remain; no safe authoritative ordering of divergent valid documents. Requires agreed backward-compatible transaction/selection design, plus user interruption tests.

findings.detail: Abrupt termination before compensation commits, absent previous local snapshot and storage denial still require manual recovery; no runtime acceptance.
findings.source_assessment: PARTIAL_SOURCE_FIX: startup rollback keeps journals; cleanup failure retains visible raw intent; failed profiles restored explicitly; autosave/migrations fenced. Still OPEN for abrupt termination, unavailable prior snapshot, durable denial and cross-store compensation.

findings.detail: Startup expected-entry destructuring and incomplete previous-entry value/uniqueness validation need focused review. No malformed-journal repair claimed.
findings.correction: validRecoveryJournal validates all entries, unique allowed key sets, string/null old values and exact checksum sets before destructuring; malformed/unsupported records retained; simultaneous intents not replayed

findings.detail: Historical multiple-of-five audit boundary reconciliation is not completed by this release.
findings.source_assessment: PARTIAL_SOURCE_FIX: explicit one-time lock exception and lineage documented; original checkpoint authoritative; stale V290 next-due label corrected to V335-R without historical credit. Historical audit reconciliation remains OPEN.

findings.root_cause: Failed safeStorage journal deletion shadowed durable intent with null, hiding recovery export and allowing another transaction
findings.correction: Restore raw intent to fallback on failed deletion and retain autosave recovery barrier

findings.root_cause: Startup local rollback cleared undo intent before mirror compensation, allowing later stale mirror promotion
findings.correction: Retain raw intent across reloads and suppress automatic mirror recovery until explicit review

findings.root_cause: Rejected profile write shadows previous durable bytes; comparing the shadow does not restore prior state
findings.correction: Explicitly restore previous profiles before clearing journal; retain on failed restoration

findings.root_cause: Recovery bundle omitted current types/catalog/import marker and acknowledgement ignored related-key changes; unreadable IndexedDB prevented any export
findings.correction: Export/capture related values, reject stale acknowledgement, clearly mark partial mirror-unavailable export and require user confirmation

findings.root_cause: Unresolved startup or failed-compensation records allowed autosave/migration to overwrite recovery sources
findings.correction: Fence autosave and startup equipment/connection/SVG storage migrations until journal acknowledgement; conflicting journals not replayed

findings.root_cause: Import cleanup callback read whichever journal was current instead of binding the save to a captured intent
findings.correction: Require exact captured import-journal bytes plus current generation/payload/marker before cleanup

findings.root_cause: PDF import dialog could close during await onImport(result), allowing another dialog while canvas mutation continues.
findings.correction: Guard close while busy; refuse replacement dialog until active import finishes; close(true) only after successful callback.

findings.root_cause: Async File.text could resolve after active document edits or navigation, then apply stale import and replace newer state.
findings.correction: Capture original document identity, persistence epoch, and exact in-memory serialized document; reject if changed after file read before preparing/applying import.

findings.root_cause: DXF/DWG asynchronous conversion and preview guarded document identity only; same-document edits could be overwritten by stale import.
findings.correction: Capture document identity, epoch and exact serialized snapshot before conversion; recheck after conversion and immediately before applying preview.

findings.root_cause: Revision undo journal removed before asynchronous mirror commit.
findings.correction: Clear only after matching mirror completion and local payload/profile checksum checks.

findings.root_cause: Async DWG preview completion overwrote active conversion status and could re-enable button while busy.
findings.correction: Guard preview success, error, finally UI updates when busy/finished.

findings.root_cause: Preview promise may settle after worker failure, when stop() clears busy, overwriting diagnostic status and controls.
findings.correction: Invalidate late preview UI writes on conversion failure in success/catch/finally.

findings.root_cause: Existing migration archive accepted arrays, unrelated keys and non-string values, treating malformed preservation as valid.
findings.correction: Validate archive object and rd_ key/value types before trusting preservation.

findings.root_cause: Exception constructing output File inside worker message callback leaves conversion Promise unsettled.
findings.correction: Catch output construction errors and report failure at output stage.
